source.title: Tadano GR-1000EX-4 spec sheet GR-1000E-4-00101/EX-04 (metric, official Tadano mediahub; linked from tadano.com/south-korea RT page)
source.page: 12 (rated lifting capacities, CW 11.2 t SMART CW2, outriggers fully extended 7.3 m, 360°); 1 (dimensions)

notes: Headline 100 t is over-front only (12.8 m @2.5 m) - excluded. 12.8 m 360° column used: 90.0 t @2.5 m and 84.10 t @3.0 m are marked ★ "with attachment sheaves". SMART CW1 = counterweight mounted at front (tail swing 4,190, slightly lower capacities, p.11); SMART CW2 = mounted at rear (tail swing 4,790, used here). "SMART CHART" pages (p.13) are not 360° and not used. Source chart has 10 columns because 22.4/31.9/41.5 m booms have telescoping modes 1 and 2; this file uses mode 1 for 22.4, 31.9, 41.5 m (12.8/17.6/51.0 are 1,2 or 1) and mode 2 for 46.2 m (only mode). Mode 2 gives higher values at long radii (e.g. 22.4 m @20 m: mode 1 5.10 t, mode 2 7.50 t) - consult source. Capacities are rated lifting capacities; hook block mass (750 kg 100 t, 500 kg 50 t, 450 kg 35 t, 165 kg 6.6 t hook per equipment list) and slings must be deducted (operation note 3). Outrigger longitudinal span = 3,550 + 3,780 mm (outrigger centres to slewing centre, p.1); transverse max 7.3 m (mid 6.7/5.5 m, min 2.7 m). Operating weight and max hook height not stated numerically. DIMS (p.1): overall 15,185 = 8,830 (boom head to front axle) + 3,950 wheelbase + 2,405; carrier length 8,580 -> front axle 2.225 m, rear axle 6.175 m from carrier front; slewing centre 1,875 mm ahead of rear axle (4.30 m); boom foot pin 2,200 mm behind slewing centre; an additional 475 mm dimension is drawn beyond the rear end (not interpreted). Tail swing 4,790 (CW2). Wheel diameter not printed (bias tyre 29.5-25), null. | 2026-09-24: special-equipment ratings [90.0, 84.1] set to null (conservative).
